Facility specific seeding pass 2026-09-02, batch 43 (Digital Realty missing-address campaign): added an address confirmed by explicit in-page operator text despite a confusing SolarCity reference elsewhere on the same listing, flagged for a future researcher to double check.

[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] Digital Realty is a publicly traded data center real estate investment trust. This session sourced two acquisitions that explain building names appearing across this operators rows in this registry. Per Data Center Dynamics trade press, Digital Realty completed a 7.8 billion dollar all-stock merger with DuPont Fabros Technology on September 15, 2017, adding 12 facilities concentrated in Ashburn, Virginia, which is why several Ashburn buildings in this registry still carry DuPont Fabros own ACC, meaning Ashburn Corporate Campus, naming convention. Separately, per Data Center Knowledge trade press, Digital Realty acquired the East Coast data center operations of AboveNet Inc. on October 2, 2006, for 40 million dollars, including a leased facility at 8100 Boone Boulevard, Vienna, Virginia, which is this registrys 8100 Boone Boulevard row. This specific row, recorded as a Digital Realty facility in Alameda County, CA under this registrys Silicon Valley market website field, matches a Fremont, CA listing at 47700 Kato Road, Fremont, CA 94538, whose page text explicitly states the facility is operated by Digital Realty. Fremont sits in Alameda County, consistent with this rows existing county level city label.

profile.facility_type_note: Part of Digital Realty's Silicon Valley (Santa Clara/San Jose area) data center campus, one of the company's largest US clusters. Two facilities in this group carry independent historic significance: 360 Spear Street and 365 Main Street in San Francisco are separate, well known carrier hotel buildings; 365 Main Street was the site of a widely covered July 2007 power outage that took down major web services including Craigslist and other sites hosted there, later becoming a Digital Realty/Digital Realty-heritage asset. SJC10 is documented at 1100 Space Park Drive per Digital Realty's own site.
